topic: Brecha de Ciberseguridad en Snowflake: Caso Ticketmaster y Santander
author: Matt Burgess / Andrei Osornio (WIRED)
rootCause: Credential theft via infostealers (Vidar, RedLine, Lumma) on unmanaged contractor BYOD endpoints + Absence of MFA and Network Policies on Snowflake accounts
verifiedSources: NIST SP 800-63B & NIST SP 800-207 Zero Trust
